require 'digest'
require 'fileutils'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module DistCache
  class CacheNode
    attr_reader :node_id, :base_path

    def initialize(node_id, base_path)
      @node_id = node_id
      @base_path = File.expand_path(base_path)
      @ring_position = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(node_id)[0..7].to_i(16)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@base_path)
    end

    def ring_position
      @ring_position
    end
  end

  class ConsistentHashRing
    def initialize(nodes, replicas: 3)
      @ring = {}
      @sorted_keys = []
      nodes.each do |node|
        replicas.times do |i|
          vnode_key = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{node.node_id}:#{i}")[0..7].to_i(16)
          @ring[vnode_key] = node
          @sorted_keys << vnode_key
        end
      end
      @sorted_keys.sort!
    end

    def get_node(key)
      hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(key.to_s)[0..7].to_i(16)
      idx = @sorted_keys.bsearch_index { |k| k >= hash } || 0
      @ring[@sorted_keys[idx]]
    end
  end

  class UploadProcessor
    ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.jpg .png .gif .pdf .txt .csv].freeze
    MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024

    def initialize(cache_ring)
      @cache_ring = cache_ring
      @upload_log = []
    end

    def process_upload(user_id, filename, content, metadata = {})
      raise "File too large" if content.bytesize > MAX_FILE_SIZE
      raise "Invalid user_id" unless user_id.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\z/)

      sanitized_name = sanitize_filename(filename)
      ext = File.extname(sanitized_name).downcase
      raise "Disallowed file type: #{ext}" unless ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)

      cache_key = generate_cache_key(user_id, sanitized_name, metadata)
      node = @cache_ring.get_node(cache_key)

      relative_path = build_storage_path(user_id, sanitized_name, metadata)
      full_path = File.join(node.base_path, relative_path)

      FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(full_path))
      File.write(full_path, content)

      @upload_log << { user: user_id, key: cache_key, node: node.node_id, time: Time.now.to_i }
      { status: :ok, cache_key: cache_key, node: node.node_id, path: relative_path }
    end

    private

    def sanitize_filename(filename)
      # Remove null bytes and normalize separators
      name = filename.to_s.gsub("\0", '')
      # Replace backslashes with forward slashes for normalization
      name = name.tr('\\', '/')
      # Extract just the basename - no directory components
      name = File.basename(name)
      # Remove any remaining dangerous characters
      name = name.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
      raise "Empty filename" if name.empty? || name == '.' || name == '..'
      name
    end

    def generate_cache_key(user_id, filename, metadata)
      components = [user_id, filename, metadata.to_json, Time.now.to_i.to_s]
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(components.join('|'))
    end

    def build_storage_path(user_id, filename, metadata)
      # Organize by category if provided in metadata
      category = resolve_category(metadata)
      date_prefix = Time.now.strftime('%Y/%m/%d')

      # Build hierarchical path: category/date/user/filename
      File.join(category, date_prefix, user_id, filename)
    end

    def resolve_category(metadata)
      base_category = metadata.fetch(:category, 'uncategorized').to_s
      # Normalize category - allow hierarchical categories with '/'
      # but prevent traversal by collapsing sequences
      normalized = base_category.gsub(/\.{2,}/, '.').gsub(/\/{2,}/, '/')
      # Strip leading/trailing slashes
      normalized = normalized.sub(/\A\/+/, '').sub(/\/+\z/, '')
      # Validate each path component
      components = normalized.split('/')
      components.map! { |c| c.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_') }
      # Rejoin - note: we check for '..' after character sanitization
      result = components.join('/')
      result.empty? ? 'uncategorized' : result
    end
  end

  class Client
    def initialize(config = {})
      nodes = (config[:nodes] || default_nodes).map do |n|
        CacheNode.new(n[:id], n[:path])
      end
      @ring = ConsistentHashRing.new(nodes)
      @processor = UploadProcessor.new(@ring)
    end

    def upload(user_id, filename, content, metadata = {})
      @processor.process_upload(user_id, filename, content, metadata)
    end

    private

    def default_nodes
      [
        { id: 'node-alpha', path: '/var/cache/distcache/alpha' },
        { id: 'node-beta', path: '/var/cache/distcache/beta' },
        { id: 'node-gamma', path: '/var/cache/distcache/gamma' }
      ]
    end
  end
end
